at1620_root_cause.description: STAGING COVERAGE BUG: old kernel staged only 2 of 16 A-tile rows per K-block. With @workgroup(32,1,1) and tile_a_size=256 (16×tile_k=16), 32 threads each loading 1 element via lane_row=lane_id/tile_k only covers rows 0 (lanes 0-15) and row 1 (lanes 16-31). Rows 2-15 remained zero-initialized. coopmat_load from shared then read mostly zeros, producing partial/wrong accumulation. GPU=[10,10,0,0] is consistent with 2 rows of correct data.
at1620_root_cause.fix: Added inner staging loops: for a_iter in range(0, tile_a_size/32) each thread covers 8 elements of A; for b_iter in range(0, tile_b_size/32) each thread covers 8 elements of B. Both tile_k=16 and tile_k=32 variants compile + spirv-val clean.
at1620_root_cause.opphi_status: NOT BROKEN — OpPhi was structurally correct (AT-1701 PASS). AT-1620 failure was purely a kernel staging coverage bug, not a compiler bug.
